description_en: Queries the list of submitted asynchronous tasks after you successfully submit an asynchronous task
description_zh: 在您成功提交异步任务以后，可以通过QueryAsyncJobList来查询已经提交的任务信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun viapi query-async-job-list --start-time 2023-01-04_00:00:00 --end-time 2023-01-04_23:00:00 --job-id E75FE679-0303-4DD1-8252-1143B4FA8A27 --pop-product ocr --pop-api-name RecognizeIdentityCard --status PROCESS_SUCCESS --page-num 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2023-01-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAsyncJobList

parameters.help_en: The RequestId returned by the asynchronous API operation

parameters.help_en: The category name in English. For more information, see the category name in English in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465341.html

parameters.help_en:
The submit status of the asynchronous task. Valid values:

QUEUING: The task is queuing.
PROCESSING: The task is being processed.
PROCESS_SUCCESS: The task is processed.
PROCESS_FAILED: The task failed to be processed.
TIMEOUT_FAILED: The task timed out.
LIMIT_RETRY_FAILED: The maximum number of retries is exceeded.
JOB_CANCELED: The task is canceled
parameters.help_zh:
异步任务状态。包括：

QUEUING：任务排队中
PROCESSING：异步处理中
PROCESS_SUCCESS：处理成功
PROCESS_FAILED：处理失败
TIMEOUT_FAILED：任务超时未处理完成
LIMIT_RETRY_FAILED：超过最大重试次数
JOB_CANCELED：任务取消
